config.record_grain: One CSV row is one point-in-time Australian Financial Services licence-register entry for a current AFS licence holder; it is not one row per condition, prior licence, address, branch, or legal entity.

fields.evidence: Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN shows the licensee ABN if provided, otherwise ACN or null. Apply ABN validator only; row 2 sample is 85007186003.
Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is mixed ABN-or-ACN, with ACN shown only if no ABN was provided. Apply ACN validator only; no ABN suffix is inferred.
Help File p.9 defines AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL as locality from the current principal business address; CSV row 2 sample is SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10 defines AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE as state from the current principal business address; CSV row 2 sample is VIC.
Help File p.10 defines AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE as postcode from the current principal business address; CSV row 2 sample is 3006; overseas postcodes may be null.
Help File p.10 defines AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY as the principal business-address country and says non-Australian countries are represented as International; row 2 sample is Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Used solely as a row filter. Help File p.8 defines it as the register name; the ontology has no register-name field.

Help File p.8 defines this as the unique AFS licence number (numeric up to 9 digits), not an entity identifier. Preserve its source string only in record provenance; the ontology has no licence-number field.

Retained through subject_label_field only. Help File p.8 calls it a register-entry name and says it can be an individual's given/family names or an organisation name, not necessarily a registered legal or trading name.
Help File p.8 defines this as the AFS licensee start date. It is licence/licensee timing and must not map to entity.date_registered.
Help File p.9 defines serialized previous register type and licence number values, possibly multiple and tilde-delimited. The ontology has no historical-licence field.
Help File p.11 defines serialized current licence authorisations/conditions in two possible formats. The ontology has no licence-condition or permission field.

limitations: Help File p.3 says this file is a point-in-time snapshot of publicly available information for current AFS licensees. The REGISTER_NAME filter retains documented AFS-register rows, but does not establish a legal-entity status, registration, or deregistration status.

AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN has no explicit per-row type label. It is mapped to both identifier targets only through their respective validators: each validator returns no value when the value is valid only as the other identifier type. No ACN is derived from an ABN suffix, and identifiers are not zero-padded.
The licence-holder label can be an individual or organisation (Help File p.8). No legal name, trading name, entity type, or entity status is asserted.

Mapped address fields are only components of the current principal business address (Help File pp.9-10), not a registered office, full street address, branch, or service location. Documentation states blank address values can mean the supplied address could not be validated.
ASIC uses the non-specific value International for addresses outside Australia (Help File p.10). It is retained as source text and is not converted into a particular country or defaulted to AU.
No row-level statement, snapshot, change, or effective timestamp is supplied. The source-envelope publication timestamp is used only as a publication proxy.
All source-reliability and field-confidence scores are provisional, uncalibrated judgements requiring human review.
